subQuests.subQuestName: Go with Yelan to the Court of Fontaine

402000102.text: Fresh Romaritime Flowers, fragrant perfume from the shop on the corner, the rich aroma of coffee beans, all blended together in the night breeze... Makes for quite the relaxing atmosphere.

402000103.text: If only we were on a rooftop terrace somewhere, enjoying a few glasses of sparkling wine and getting pleasantly tipsy...

402000106.text: Alright... Then let's look for a place to stop. I wonder what special drinks the hidden taverns of this city offer...

402000107.text: Ah, but first. I wanted to head to the Confrerie of Cabriere before it closes. Mind helping me pick out some perfume to go with this outfit?

402000108.text: I also heard about the intricate timepieces, clockwork furnishings, and fine jewelry you can get around here. There should be quite a few souvenirs worth perusing.

402000201.text: So you're saying that Officer Fonck is going to take us to where the bad guys are being questioned, right?

402000202.text: That's right. We're giving you the chance to check out our secret base...

402000203.text: Haha, I'm only joking. To make sure we don't disturb everyone's day-to-day work, we've set up shop in a remote house. Once we set off, you'd better stay close to me, okay?

402000204.text: #Don't worry! Paimon's a very experienced guide, she and {NICKNAME} have been to all sorts of confusing places. No way she'll get lost in Fontaine!

402000206.text: That was quick! Is Yelan one of those close-your-eyes-for-a-second-and-okay-that's-enough-rest-let's-get-back-to-work sort of people?

402000209.text: Hehe, Paimon's fine, there's no need to worry. You're not the only one who can grow!

402000210.text: Everything's been taken care of, so you and Yelan can go and enjoy your holiday!

402000211.text: Throw all your troubles aside and have fun!

402000212.text: And for my part, I'll make sure Inspector Paimon's well looked after. Whatever she wants to learn, whatever she wants to eat, we'll ensure her needs are met!
